item.title: Migraine Prevention: A Strategic Approach to Reducing Attacks
item.description: Learn how migraine prevention really works, from medications to lifestyle stabilization and nervous system regulation.

item.description: Understand the main types of migraines, their symptoms and classifications, and when to seek medical care for safer, more targeted treatment.

item.description: Alternative treatment for migraines, including acupuncture, biofeedback, supplements, and stress therapy to reduce symptoms, frequency, and breakthrough pain.

item.description: Watch the Migraine World Summit live each March for 7 days or get lifetime access to 30+ expert interviews on chronic migraine treatments.

item.description: Explore the Migraine World Summit highlights archive with expert insights from past events. Learn from leading migraine and headache specialists.

item.title: What Causes Migraines: Emerging Theories & Gene Links to Migraine
item.description: The “TRESK” gene and gene “rs1835740” have been discovered and linked to migraine. Will your genes tell you what causes migraines, will this mean more targeted medications?

item.title: Migraine Causes Explained: Biology, Genetics & Triggers
item.description: Learn what causes migraines, including genetics, brain chemistry, hormones, and why migraine causes differ from triggers.

item.title: Migraine Relief: Practical Strategies to Reduce Pain & Duration
item.description: Learn practical migraine relief strategies, including early medication timing, ice therapy, rest, and devices to reduce pain and shorten attacks.

item.title: Foods to Prevent Migraine Headaches: Nutrition Strategies That Work
item.description: Practical foods to prevent migraine headaches using a recovery-focused cooking method and nutrient-dense strategies to reduce trigger load and aid recovery.

item.title: Associated Migraine Conditions: Linked Health Issues Explained
item.description: Associated migraine conditions include depression, stroke risk, sleep disorders, fibromyalgia, and more. Learn how these linked health issues overlap.
